advanced_license.recommended: MANDATORY — boat is the only way to reach Skarvika and the deep fjord. Without boat access, only Ranvika Marina shore is fishable. $4,000 unlimited is the right buy given the $50k travel; you'll want to maximize each trip.

ocean_vs_freshwater.summary: Ocean fishing is fundamentally different from FP's lake/river mechanics. Skarland Fjord operates on saltwater rules — your freshwater rod/reel/bait playbook doesn't translate.
key_differences: FISH CLASS WEIGHT — saltwater species reach 200-1000+ lb (Greenland Shark up to 1,400 lb in real life; FP cap likely 600-1000+ lb). Conventional reels CANNOT handle these, even L'Impulsion 12000 SE (81.5 Lb drag).

ELECTRIC REELS REQUIRED — Saltwater Casting E-Reels (AmperDrive X 24000 SE 315 Lb, Arcspark 2W 22000 SE 243 Lb, Glacion 21000 SE 172 Lb) are mandatory. The electric mechanism auto-fights the fish to some extent — different gameplay loop than spinning/casting reels.

BAITS ARE SALTWATER-SPECIFIC — Sea Worms, Sand Fleas, Crab, Atlantic Mackerel Cut Baits, Bluey, Seal Blubber, Large Fish Strips, Finger Mullets, Scaled Sardine. Freshwater baits (Shiners, Worms, Bloodworms) WILL NOT WORK.
DEPTH RANGES — Fjord water is much deeper than lakes. Sinkers in the 13-35 oz range (vs typical 1-7 oz freshwater). Tungsten sinkers preferred for cold deep water (denser, sinks faster).
LINE/LEADER WEIGHTS — main lines in .02-.055" diameter (vs .008-.014" freshwater). Leaders in .04-.07" (vs .015-.018" freshwater). Norwegian saltwater = MUCH thicker tackle.
BOAT REQUIRED — Shore fishing at Ranvika Marina is limited; boat fishing at Skarvika is where the trophy class lives. Valkyrie Fishing Boat is the Skarland-grade vessel.

TROLL VS BOTTOM — Most of your saltwater rigs are bottom rigs (heavy sinker + bait dropped). Trolling may unlock with specific lures/setups. The 'Allow for Livebait trolling' note on Bluey suggests trolling is possible at Skarland.
WEATHER MATTERS MORE — Fjord weather (storms, fog, swell) affects fish activity at higher amplitude than lakes. Watch for clear-day/calm-water windows for trophy attempts.

income_review.summary: Skarland is an XP and trophy location, NOT an income farm. $50k travel + $4k unlimited Advanced license = $54k pre-trip cost. To break even you need $50k+ from each session. Single big-fish catches (Greenland Shark, Sea Sturgeon) likely produce $30-60k+ per fish, but volume catches of cod/mackerel/herring may not cover trip costs alone.

comparison_to_other_locations.vs_congo: Skarland's monster ceiling (Greenland Shark 1000+ lb) likely exceeds Congo's Nile Perch 452 lb. But Congo has higher density of catchable trophies; Skarland is fewer-but-bigger.
comparison_to_other_locations.vs_bci: BCI is volume saltwater (24 species, 154 lb max Tarpon). Skarland is monster saltwater (25 species, much higher class). BCI for income; Skarland for trophy XP.
comparison_to_other_locations.vs_dnipro: Dnipro is mid-tier Euro freshwater. Skarland is endgame saltwater. Different gear class entirely. No overlap in tackle or technique.

session_economics.verdict: Skarland is HIGH-VARIANCE income. Treat it like a trophy hunt, not an income grind. If you need cash, fish Saint-Croix Floating Dock; if you want endgame XP, fish here.
